title: HealthInformatics EDTriageModelLaunch

stats.done_summary: Completed the evaluation of TriageAssist-B vs TriageAssist-A. Generated visualizations for offline and online metrics, and relative changes. Wrote a comprehensive report detailing the methodology, results, and discussion, concluding that TriageAssist-B suffers from severe miscalibration leading to over-triage and operational degradation, and recommending against its deployment.
